The topic of "Recommendation" in this corpus refers to specific clinical guidelines governing the diagnostic workflow for acute abdominal emergencies. These recommendations are directly associated with the quality metric [[indikator-2|Indikator 2]]. The guidelines stress the urgency of imaging for patients suspected of having life-threatening conditions such as bowel ischemia, a perforated hollow organ, or ileus. According to the protocol, it is recommended that all such patients undergo a CT scan with contrast as quickly as possible during their admission [^src1]. 

Time is a critical factor in these recommendations. To ensure that patients can be operated on within six hours of their admission, the guidelines stipulate that the CT scanning process must be initiated within two hours [^src1]. By tightly coupling the imaging timeline to the surgical timeline, these recommendations aim to minimize delays in the treatment of acute abdominal conditions, with compliance tracked via Indikator 2.

## Claims
- Det anbefales at alle patienter med mistanke om tarm iskæmi, perforeret hulorgan eller ileus gennemgår CT scanning med kontrast så hurtigt som muligt i deres indlæggelsesforløb [^src1] (indikator-2)
